note: The maintained declaration of format samples for tools/caepipe_correlation/sitting_pack.py: small invented, hand-authored models outside the benchmark set, each run only to see how the external program prints the sections named in `prints`. Each entry binds an id to a model file beside this declaration by its SHA-256; the file needs an invented-provenance sidecar <stem>.provenance.json (produced_by_caepipe false). A sample is designated here before its first run, never by a plan; a benchmark model, under any id, is never a format sample. Entries: id, file, sha256, title, prints, and an optional instruction (what is done by hand before analysing).

samples.title: Invented format sample: modes requested in the file, run by the batch command
samples.prints: whether the batch command, given a file whose dynamics options request modes, prints any modal section, and which section titles, column headers and unit rows it prints

samples.title: Invented format sample: modal and response-spectrum prints from the program's window
samples.prints: the section titles, column headers and unit rows of the frequency, participation, mode shape and response-spectrum prints
samples.instruction: In the program's window apply the spectrum FSSPEC1 in X, Y and Z with factors 1, 1 and 0.67, tick the modal and response-spectrum load cases, analyse, and print every result of every load case to file.
